approval_required_for: Adopting a planned_tool.<short_name> or planned_checker.<short_name> as an approved workaround for a missing checker-verified capability
Any change to artifact.input.design_space hard_constraints, objectives, or qor_targets
Any change to artifact.input.human_agent_boundary or constraint.human.boundary
Any major template_library/template_metadata binding override outside the already selected template set
Changing numeric precision/quantization policy, compare tolerance, or memory layout away from a case-adapter-supplied value.
Promoting to stage_sacg_extraction while unresolved numeric, DDR/AXI, runtime, or deployment facts remain open in artifact.stage0.board_open_risks.
Substituting missing numeric_policy or target_board_profile facts with inferred defaults, generic board names, DUT output, or generated expected values.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep input-preparation readiness blocked, record the missing or conflicting source identity as not_run/gap in artifact.stage0.source_material_trace, and request upstream material_index/sample_project_index rows before SACG extraction.
executable_actions.rationale: material_index and sample_project_index are not visible in the compact prepared_inputs.inputs slice, so the current run identity and source-project scope must be bound to the visible run_dir and case_adapter case_id before the evidence audit can pass.

executable_actions.on_failure: Mark tool capability alignment as not_run or conflicted in the audit, block promotion to SACG extraction, and request current-run tool_profile/tool_availability details from the upstream input registry.
executable_actions.rationale: case_adapter exposes acceptance and protocol-related keys, but tool_profile and tool_availability detailed rows are not visible in the compact slice; tool_protocol_check must confirm that case-adapter protocols are supported by the current tool set.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep field_evidence outside the accepted-evidence boundary, record the gate as not_run/failed, and do not allow downstream SACG extraction to consume it as accepted evidence.
executable_actions.rationale: field_evidence_candidates and field_evidence are present, but the visible candidate artifact does not show checker evidence that the candidates were accepted through case_adapter.evidence_gates; this must be verified before accepted field evidence enters SACG extraction.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not pass stage0 or promote to SACG extraction; record missing model facts as artifact.stage0.model_open_facts and request case-adapter model_config/task_card evidence.
executable_actions.rationale: Run the registered model_config and task_card checkers on the declared input artifacts to determine whether decoder-block, shape, head, sequence, attention, residual, and operator-order facts are present and bound to model constraints rather than inferred from board or numeric artifacts.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep artifact.stage0.model_open_facts open and route to the toolchain boundary gate; do not treat missing model facts as hidden or inferred details.
executable_actions.rationale: Persist the audit and open model facts in shared sacg_memory so downstream toolchain_boundary_engineer and stage_sacg_extraction consume only checker-bound model evidence.

executable_actions.on_failure: If either artifact is absent or cannot be hash-bound to the current run_dir/prepared_inputs identity, record a board_open_risks entry and do not run numeric/board content checks against guessed paths; request the case adapter to re-emit the input artifact.
executable_actions.rationale: The compact prepared_inputs slice omits detailed keys for artifact.input.numeric_policy and artifact.input.target_board_profile even though the state summary declares them. Hash-check both current artifacts before any content audit to distinguish a missing input from an omitted detail row.

executable_actions.on_failure: If numeric_policy_check or addr_map_check reports missing precision/quantization policy, DDR/AXI address map, transfer-width, burst, runtime, or deployment facts, do not derive defaults from DUT output or generic knowledge. Record each exact missing field in artifact.stage0.board_open_risks and hand off as a blocker to input_preparation.toolchain_boundary_engineer and stage_sacg_extraction. If checker execution raises an artifact-location exception, return to verify.numeric_board_artifact_identity.
executable_actions.rationale: Bind explicit facts from numeric_policy and target_board_profile to the named numeric, memory, runtime, and deployment constraints before downstream SACG extraction. Missing facts must become open risks, not inferred defaults.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not clear the numeric/board gap. Keep stage_sacg_extraction gated for unresolved facts and mark the SACG memory update failed for replanning.
executable_actions.rationale: Persist checker-bound numeric/board gaps and evidence provenance in SACG memory so downstream toolchain-boundary and extraction agents receive the open-risk list without receiving invented board facts.

executable_actions.on_failure: Block stage_sacg_extraction, record the violated constraint/artifact as an input-preparation blocker in sacg_memory, and return the bounded repair or approval item to the owning specialist; do not rewrite the inputs or bypass the checker.
executable_actions.rationale: The readiness gate must be grounded in checker evidence that template_library/template_metadata bind to the selected design_space and case_adapter, tool_protocols support checker-verified execution, and human_agent_boundary defines approval/forbidden actions without contradictory auto-allowed paths.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep artifact.stage0.input_readiness_gate unapproved, block stage_sacg_extraction, and route each failed invariant back to the responsible specialist with the consumed artifact and checker status; do not aggregate contradictory audit findings into a false ready state.
executable_actions.rationale: The toolchain-boundary audit is necessary but not sufficient; model, numeric/board, and field-evidence specialist findings must be merged into one checker-verified readiness decision before SACG extraction can consume the aggregate.

source_roles.board_materials_dir: current-run target FPGA board, DDR/AXI, runtime, and sample-project materials
source_roles.quantization_materials_dir: current-run numeric and quantization design materials
source_roles.tool_materials_dir: current-run EDA tool location, usage, and limitation materials
